svg.text: CUSTOMER CHURN MLOPS ARCHITECTURE (with DVC, Optuna & MLflow)
Automated task detection, hyperparameter tuning, multi-criteria champion gating, and containerized cloud deployment flow.

g.text: LR, DT, RF, HGB, NB, SVM, KNN
If no model meets < 5% gap, selects smallest-gap fallback; if continuous
target is configured, routes automatically to 6 Regression estimators.
DVC DATA PIPELINE & ARTIFACT LINEAGE (Zero Leakage)
Always enforce zero data leakage and < 5.0% train-val gap first. Among top accuracy finalists (within 1.0%),
select the fastest, smallest champion (DecisionTree: 16 KB, 99.98% test accuracy) and deploy via Docker to AWS EC2.
